tagline: All your crew housing. One hub.
brief: A Saudi platform where companies find, book and manage housing for their workforce in one place. It should feel modern, techy, solid and trustworthy, and say 'housing' at a glance without clip-art.
criteria: Success: says housing instantly, integrates with the name, readable at 16 px, works in one colour, bilingual (Latin + Arabic), avoids generic Saudi green and proptech blue.

concepts.name: The n is a home
concepts.idea: The n in sakan becomes a home, with the hub (a dot) at its door: the name is the logo.
rationale: Built on the Noto Sans Bold grid: same stem, roof apex on the ascender line, inner roof on the x-height
Clay accent (#C8502A) owns a warm, Najdi-earth colour in a category of greens and blues
Bilingual lockups with Noto Kufi Arabic; dot-free favicon cut for 16 px

recommendation: Approved direction. Ink #1D2433 for the wordmark, clay #C8502A for the home.
next_steps: Trademark pre-search with an IP lawyer (combined mark, Arabic + Latin)
Apply to website, deck template and signage
